name: Read AI
summary: AI meeting notetaker and assistant for Teams, Meet and Zoom, with search across meetings and messages.
description: Read AI joins meetings on Microsoft Teams, Google Meet and Zoom to produce transcripts, summaries and meeting reports, and offers apps for Windows, macOS, iOS and Android. It is also available as a Claude connector, ChatGPT app and MCP server. Workspaces and an AI assistant are offered for teams and enterprises.

howToUse.title: Open Read AI
howToUse.description: Open Read AI and add it to a meeting on Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, or Zoom.

howToUse.title: Let it join and write the report
howToUse.description: Read AI joins the meeting and produces transcripts, summaries, and meeting reports.

howToUse.title: Use the apps and connectors
howToUse.description: Download the Windows, macOS, iOS, or Android app, or use the Claude connector, the ChatGPT app, and the MCP server.

howToUse.title: Open a workspace for the team
howToUse.description: Open a workspace for the team. Workspaces, and an assistant, are offered for teams and enterprises.
